title: Pac-Man
description: Eat every dot and dodge four ghosts in a faithful remake of Pac-Man, with Ms. Pac-Man and random Cookie-Man mazes. Free in your browser.
about:
This Pac-Man is an accurate remake of the 1980 arcade classic, rebuilt from research into how the original machine really works. The ghosts follow their authentic personalities: Blinky chases you directly, Pinky tries to cut you off, and Inky and Clyde keep you guessing.

From the title screen you can choose three games. Pac-Man uses the famous original maze, Ms. Pac-Man brings her colorful mazes, and Cookie-Man generates brand new random mazes as you advance. Each game also offers a Turbo mode, a Practice mode where you can pick a level, slow down time and rewind, the classic cutscenes, and a Learn screen that introduces the ghosts and fruit.

It is perfect for retro fans who want the real arcade feel, and for newcomers who want a place to practice before chasing a high score.
howToPlay: Pick Pac-Man, Ms. Pac-Man or Cookie-Man on the title screen, then choose Play. Guide your hero through the maze and eat every dot to clear the level. Avoid the four ghosts, or eat a flashing power pellet to turn them blue and chase them for bonus points. Grab the fruit when it appears for extra score. You lose a life when a ghost catches you, earn an extra life at 10,000 points, and the game ends when all lives are gone. On a keyboard use the arrow keys; on a phone or tablet swipe anywhere or use the on-screen D-pad.

controls.action: Pause and open the in-game menu / go back
Move Pac-Man on touch screens (the turn is queued until the next corner)
Open the in-game menu on touch screens
Practice mode: rewind, slow motion (also available as on-screen buttons)

tips: Press, swipe or tap the D-pad toward the next direction just before a corner: the turn is remembered, so Pac-Man takes it without slowing down.
Save the power pellets until ghosts are close, then eat as many blue ghosts as you can for up to 1600 points each.
Pac-Man moves slightly faster through empty corridors than when eating dots, so clear paths are good escape routes.
Use Practice mode to pick a later level and study how the ghosts behave before playing for real.

faq.question: Is Pac-Man free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. It is completely free and runs in your browser with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. The maze fills the screen in portrait or landscape, with an on-screen D-pad placed outside the maze. You can also swipe anywhere to steer, and tap the menus and the pause button.

faq.question: What is the difference between Pac-Man, Ms. Pac-Man and Cookie-Man?
faq.answer: They share the same rules but use different mazes: the original Pac-Man maze, the Ms. Pac-Man mazes, or randomly generated mazes in Cookie-Man. Your high score is saved in your browser for each game.

faq.question: Is my high score saved?
faq.answer: Yes. The best score for each game and speed is saved in your browser, so it is still there next time you play on the same device.
